name: 3615-ucodia
description: The Internet of the future past 🌈

scripts.esp32:core-check: arduino-cli core list | grep -E '^esp32:esp32 +2\.0\.' >/dev/null || { echo 'ESP32 core 2.0.x required (the sketch does not run on 3.x): arduino-cli core install esp32:esp32@2.0.17' >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.esp32:build: npm run esp32:core-check && npm run esp32:config && arduino-cli compile --fqbn esp32:esp32:esp32 esp32/client
scripts.esp32:flash: npm run esp32:build && arduino-cli upload --fqbn esp32:esp32:esp32:UploadSpeed=115200 -p ${ESP32_PORT:-/dev/cu.usbserial-0001} esp32/client

author: Lionel Ringenbach / @ucodia
